request.subject: UNIT:UNDEAD:SWORDSMAN

layers.text: Redraw him as a heavy armoured barrow-king: a closed dark rusted iron great helm hides the whole skull, with two glowing violet eye slits and a spiky tarnished bronze crown on top; a dark iron chainmail coat and two big round rusted iron pauldrons cover the ribs and arms. Remove the shield and the sword: he holds one huge notched two-handed greataxe with a broad light grey iron blade above his head. Keep bone hands and feet, proportions, black outline and style, transparent background.
